Stand between the plants and the dry stone walls. In this spot, you have a wide field of view and the ogres can never reach you.]] '''Ogres''' are a [[monster]] found throughout [[Gielinor]], most notably the ogre city of [[Gu'Tanoth]]. The best place to kill ogres for [[Slayer]] is directly west of [[Yanille]], near where [[Og]] is situated and the small island, although the location may be crowded with [[Dwarf multicannon|cannon]] users that can make training there inhospitable; if that's the case, it is possible to kill the ogres camping in the ruins immediately to the north, behind a line of trees, as those are not affected by the cannon. Alternatively, if the player has level 46 [[Thieving]], they can access the [[Chaos Druid Tower]] that has 7 ogres in its dungeon, where it is usually quiet. After completion of [[Biohazard]], caged ogres found in the [[Combat Training Camp]] can also be fought using [[ranged]] and [[magic]]; [[melee]] in the training camp is possible if using a [[halberd]] to attack the ogres through the caging.
